info.title: Voxys Connect - CRM APIs
info.description: CRM API documentation for Voxys Connect, covering Leads, Companies, Pipelines, Follow-up Tasks, and Conversation CRM.

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Manage CRM leads including creation, status changes, notes, and conversion.

tags.name: Companies
tags.description: Manage companies, their contacts, timelines, and duplicate merging.

tags.name: Pipelines
tags.description: Manage sales funnels (pipelines), their stages, and kanban cards.

tags.name: Follow-up Tasks
tags.description: Create and manage follow-up tasks attached to leads, deals, or conversations.

tags.name: Conversation CRM
tags.description: CRM panel within a conversation: link pipelines, leads, and convert to deal.

userApiKey.name: api_access_token
userApiKey.description: API access token for authentication. Obtain from your Voxys Connect profile settings.

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

custom_attributes.description: Flexible key-value map of custom attributes defined for the account.

params.description: Additional params depending on action_type, e.g. {"assigned_agent_id": 5} or {"status": "won"}

target_company_id.description: The ID of the company that will survive the merge. The source company will be deleted.

stage_ids.description: Ordered list of stage IDs representing the new order.

description.example: Card moved from Qualification to Proposal.

duration.description: Snooze duration. Accepts values like '1h', '1d', '1w', or an ISO 8601 datetime string.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of leads for the account, with optional filtering and sorting.

parameters.name: assigned_agent_id
parameters.description: Filter leads assigned to a specific agent.

parameters.name: source_inbox_id
parameters.description: Filter leads originating from a specific inbox.

post.description: Creates a new lead in the account.

get.description: Returns aggregate statistics for leads in the account.

post.description: Perform a bulk action (assign, change status, delete) on multiple leads at once.

get.description: Returns details for a single lead.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing lead.
Changes the status of a lead (e.g., open, won, lost, snoozed) with optional notes.

parameters.name: lead_id
parameters.description: The ID of the lead to convert.

post.description: Converts a lead into a pipeline card (deal) in the specified funnel and optional stage.

201.description: Lead converted; returns the new funnel card.

get.description: Returns all notes attached to a lead.

post.description: Adds a new note to a lead.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of companies.
Full-text search across company names and domains.
Returns details for a single company.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing company.

get.description: Returns chronological activity events associated with a company.
Returns a list of companies that may be duplicates of the given company, based on name or domain similarity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the source company (will be deleted after merge).

post.description: Merges the source company into a target company. All contacts and data are moved to the target; the source is deleted.

200.description: Merge completed. Returns the surviving target company.

get.description: Returns all contacts associated with the company.

post.summary: Add a contact to a company
post.description: Associates an existing contact with the company.

parameters.name: contact_id
parameters.description: The ID of the contact to remove.

delete.summary: Remove a contact from a company
delete.description: Disassociates a contact from the company (does not delete the contact).

get.description: Returns all pipelines (funnels) for the account.
Returns details for a single pipeline.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing pipeline.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a pipeline and all its stages and cards.

get.description: Returns aggregate statistics for a pipeline.
Returns all stages for a pipeline, ordered by position.

post.description: Adds a new stage to a pipeline.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing pipeline stage.

delete.description: Deletes a pipeline stage. Cards in the stage must be moved or deleted beforehand.

422.description: Cannot delete stage with existing cards

post.description: Updates the display order of stages within a pipeline.

get.description: Returns all cards (deals) in a pipeline, with optional filtering by stage or lead status.

parameters.name: lead_status
parameters.description: Filter cards by the associated lead status.

post.description: Creates a new card (deal) in a pipeline. You may link an existing lead or provide lead fields to create one inline.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing pipeline card.

post.description: Moves a card to a different stage and/or position within the pipeline.

404.description: Card or target stage not found

get.description: Returns the full activity history for a pipeline card (stage moves, field changes, etc.).
Returns detailed analytics for a pipeline within a date range, optionally grouped.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Filter analytics to a specific agent.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Grouping dimension for time-series or breakdown data.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of follow-up tasks, with optional filtering.

parameters.name: taskable_type
parameters.description: Filter tasks by the type of attached entity.

parameters.name: taskable_id
parameters.description: Filter tasks by the ID of the attached entity. Requires taskable_type.

parameters.name: due_before
parameters.description: Return tasks due before this timestamp.

parameters.name: due_after
parameters.description: Return tasks due after this timestamp.

post.description: Creates a new follow-up task, optionally attached to a lead, deal, conversation, or contact.

get.description: Returns follow-up tasks within a date range, suitable for rendering in a calendar view.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the follow-up task.

get.description: Returns details for a single follow-up task.

patch.description: Updates fields of an existing follow-up task.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the follow-up task.

patch.description: Marks a follow-up task as completed and records the completion timestamp.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the follow-up task.

patch.description: Snoozes a task for the specified duration, updating its due_at and setting status to snoozed.

get.description: Returns CRM data associated with a conversation, including linked lead, pipeline card, and follow-up tasks.

post.description: Associates an existing pipeline card (deal) with the conversation.

delete.description: Removes the pipeline card association from the conversation. The card is not deleted.

post.description: Associates an existing lead with the conversation.
Converts a lead linked to the conversation into a pipeline card (deal) in the specified funnel and stage.

201.description: Deal created; returns the new funnel card.

404.description: Conversation, lead, or funnel not found
